verdict.rationale: Jira's docs mention breaking big ideas into actionable tasks (jira-docs-10) and customizable workflows (jira-docs-13), which implies task decomposition, but no evidence explicitly documents subtasks or issue-linking (blocks/depends-on) features that make blocking order visible. Community commentary focuses on UI/performance complaints rather than confirming or denying dependency-linking functionality. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of subtask creation, issue-link types (blocks/is blocked by), and dependency visualization (e.g., timeline/roadmap dependency arrows), plus independent confirmation these work well in practice.
